name: ayahflow
description: Offline-first Quran recall and guided Tajweed practice for iOS, Android and web.

scripts.ios:add: npm run native:prepare && cap add ios && node scripts/native-configure.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.android:add: npm run native:prepare && cap add android && node scripts/native-configure.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.native:sync: npm run native:prepare && node scripts/native-configure.mjs && cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run native:sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run native:sync && cap open android
